Its portfolio spans bioenergy (BioMobility ethanol, bio-isobutanol, Sustainable Aviation Fuel, 2G ethanol, compressed biogas, co-product valorization and bio-bitumen), BioPrism bio-based materials, and an engineering business covering Praj HiPurity Systems, brewery and beverages, water and wastewater treatment, critical process equipment and modularization, plus lifecycle services, O&M and modernization. risks.note: Management lists policy and regulatory uncertainties among its key ERM risks, and the BRSR material-issues table states 'The biofuel industry is dependent on government mandates. Failure to properly navigate these regulatory pathways can lead to execution barriers, project delays, or significant fines.' Mitigation is to track evolving biofuel and environmental mandates, engage with regulatory bodies and build operational flexibility to pivot when laws change.
risks.risk: Policy and regulatory dependence of the biofuel industry
